full_page.content:
1935, July
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 6.
Page 19 Cont.
July 29 Sam Cataldo - 24 - T.B. T.B. fearful operation - July 12 lost four ribs, another X ray To-morrow - 6 operations lost kidney in one. Kath. Detrick - 40 - wants work or vacation ... Josephine Aragone - 44 - inward cancer (womb)
Page 20 July 29 Josephine
Fred Kniffel - 56 - n.Cat. - rhumatism two yrs ....
Tillie Oles - 42 - goitre operation over year ago; now seems to be ulcers of stomach.
Dorothy Langley - 28 - Ep. fits since 15 yrs. was her last Wed. - has been well since ....
Mary Dupon - 34 - operation over a year ago .... fears other ..
Page 21 July Josephine Charles R. Smith - 10 - badly deformed - pneumonia - was absolutely given up - Mother about to rush home to Penn'a wonderfully improved ..
Mr. & Mrs. Stevens - lost only daughter. . .. 31 Frank Buxlitner - 40 - treated for infected nose - said to be cancer. This was last Saturday. Enrolled July 28 - last Sunday .... Decidedly better To-day ... Thanks be to God.
Bregetta Hopper - 37 - wants to get lighter for a number of sane rea- sons - weighs now 210
Page 22 July 31 Mr. Fieretta - 2515 Garland - about 62 - cancer of stomach - dreads ..
Property to Sell - Mrs. Mary Kliemann - 1501 Mcclellan - Cor. St. Paul - has double house to sell - good sized house - 15 rooms "all toll".
Earl J. Henthorn - 45 - convert - left wife to associate with his wife's brother. Wife a convert also. In 1931 June 3rd was reported to wife as killed. Though she attended the funeral, she was doubtful then if it were really her husband killed. Her doubts still continue - asks pray- ers that it clear up.
